Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Forced the visible Market Board listing window to sync after each listing data request is accepted so the title/icon stays aligned with the item list being read and purchased. Also preserved armoury-section metadata when reading visible search results.
